description: 擅长避战的奴隶探索者。棋盘最大、背得最多、带的钱也最多：先手偷袭、输了就用钱买命。生命 {max_hp}、体力 {vitality_max} 都是最低的。

descriptions.en: A slave explorer who avoids fights. Biggest board, load and purse: he ambushes first and buys his life back. Lowest Health {max_hp} and Vitality {vitality_max}.

skills.description: 开战时敌人先失去三成生命。能用 {uses} 次，每到休息点补 {rest_recharge} 次。

descriptions.en: The enemy starts three tenths down on Health. {uses} uses, +{rest_recharge} per rest spot.

skills.description: 打输了可以用金币和道具抵掉体力损失。核心点与搜索遭遇不能。

descriptions.en: Lost a fight? Pay coins and items instead of Vitality (not at the core or in searches).

skills.description: 每走 {travel_discount_every} 步，下一步不计入倒计时。

descriptions.en: Every {travel_discount_every} steps, one step skips the Countdown.

skills.description: 猎手更难发现你，从猎手面前逃跑更容易。

descriptions.en: Hunters notice you less; fleeing is easier.
